tagline: AI and automation for your business
lead: We deploy AI agents that take over the dull computer work — the kind that eats most of your time and drains your energy. Your team can focus on what they enjoy and what actually moves the business.

card.label: Sivak.ai business card
card.rule: Routine takes most of the time and delivers the least. We automate it first — that's where AI pays off fastest.

services.title: AI agents on your team
services.text: They handle requests and check documents. The agent prepares, a person decides.

services.title: Process automation
services.text: We connect systems that don't talk to each other. No more retyping data.

services.title: Robots for legacy software
services.text: They operate programs with no API — Helios, DOS applications and in-house systems.

card.case: For a software company, we run agents that investigate customer tickets and test new releases.
